summary_en: Interim dividend per share for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 increased from 15 yen to 20 yen, comprising ordinary dividend of 15 yen and special commemorative dividend of 5 yen marking the company's 20th anniversary. Full-year dividend forecast raised from 45 yen to 50 yen (on a post-split basis).
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Interim Dividend Forecast (20th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief: Copro-Holdings increased its interim dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend per share was raised from 15 yen to 20 yen, consisting of an ordinary dividend of 15 yen and a special commemorative dividend of 5 yen. Consequently, the full-year dividend forecast was revised upward from 45 yen to 50 yen on a post-split adjusted basis. The company noted that this increase was implemented to mark its 20th anniversary on October 2, 2026, and to express gratitude to shareholders and stakeholders for their long-standing support. The company stated that operating performance has progressed broadly as expected, with an upward revision to earnings guidance accompanying the announcement of first-quarter results for fiscal 2027. The company also indicated that it plans to announce its next medium-term management plan in the coming spring. Note: the company conducted a 1-for-2 stock split on October 1, 2025, making direct year-over-year comparison of dividend per share amounts impractical without adjustment.
